يتبلور (form IIq)
# يَتَبَلْوَرُ (yatabalwaru) /ja.ta.bal.wa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَلْوَرَ (tabalwara)
# يُتَبَلْوَرُ (yutabalwaru) /ju.ta.bal.wa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَلْوَرَ (tabalwara)
# يَتَبَلْوَرَ (yatabalwara) /ja.ta.bal.wa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَ
